speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The music came in four bars early. The entrance is on the fifth bar, not the first. We played the first four to an empty door.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I heard the music and I came. If the music is early, I will be early. Tell me which bar is the true one, and I will wait for it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Four bars of a tune, and a man already in the door talking over it. I cannot fence with a speech I cannot hear. Hold him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hold the entrance. Phillips, give him the fifth bar until he can hear it without looking at you.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Fifth bar. I will lift my hand on it, once, this morning. At two I will not lift it. The bar has to be in his ear.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Fifth. I will count. I would rather count than come in on a kindness.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Count quietly. A counted bar that the yard can see is another play, and not this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. From the top of the tune. Nobody moves on the first bar.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: That was the third. You have spent the third. The fifth is still coming, and you are already speaking.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I am sorry. The third felt like a summons. I will wait. Say it again, and I will not move my foot until I see your hand, and then I will learn to do it without the hand.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Do it without the apology as well. I am standing here with a sword that has opinions, and the opinions are all about being ready.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sword can be ready on the fifth, with him. Not before. You are not fighting the tune.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Once more. I will give the hand this once. After that, four bars of nothing from the door. Silence is the cue for the wait. The fifth is the cue for the man.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Four of nothing. Then me. I have learned a line in my sleep. I can learn a rest.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There. That is a door, and not a collision. I can work with a door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again, without the hand. If he misses, we stop. If he makes it, we go to dinner in our heads and leave the scene alone.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No hand. Fifth bar. I will look at the floor, so I cannot help him by accident.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: That was the fifth. I counted on my fingers, inside the fist, where Pope could not see the numbers.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I did not see them. Keep them there. I will be on my side of it at two, and I will not count for you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two of the clock. The fifth bar. The first four belong to the music and to nobody's feet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will not rescue it in the afternoon. If he is early, he is early in front of the yard, and we go on.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will not be early. Four, and then me. I can say that now, and I will do it at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the morning has done its work. Eat. Leave the sword and the tune in the house until the half hour.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will eat. I will count four bars before I come through any door, including the one to the meat.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Count them in your fist. I have no interest in your fingers over a plate.
